svg.aria-label: Grid of crescent samples from four samplers at about 5, 10 and 20 network calls beside the exact ODE endpoints of the same three starting noises
svg.text: THE SAME THREE STARTING NOISES · 32×32 CRESCENTS · EXACT DENOISER
Measured by the lab: EDM's ρ = 7 grid from σ = 80; Heun's budgets are odd (2N − 1). Ancestral draws fresh noise,
so its images are different crescents from the exact ones by design. Display: −1.6 black to +1.6 white, high = bright.
